items.title: Backend Architecture & High Concurrency
items.description: Designed the microservice architecture for a gaming and live-streaming platform, separating each game format into its own API, Socket, business service, and asynchronous consumer so that each scales horizontally by load. The system sustained high-concurrency traffic during draws and peak hours, with Kafka carrying cross-service event streams, Redis and Bull Queue handling caching and asynchronous settlement, and Socket.IO delivering live rounds and draw results.

items.title: Performance Tuning & Refactoring
items.description: Locates bottlenecks through measurement before making changes. A recommendation query was reduced from 5 seconds to milliseconds by replacing runtime JSON parsing with virtual generated columns and composite indexes, and peak database connections decreased by 24%. Also responsible for MySQL index optimization, Redis caching design, and refactoring of legacy code.

items.title: Node.js / React.js
items.description: Node.js / NestJS on the backend and React / Next.js (including App Router) on the frontend, sharing a single language across both, enabling independent delivery from database and API through to interface. Frontend performance falls within the same scope: one product's first paint was reduced from 10 seconds to 1.4 seconds. Mobile experience includes Flutter.

items.title: Self-Built RAG and Evaluation Framework
items.description: Implemented a RAG framework from scratch in Python (FastAPI) without LangChain, in order to retain full control over retrieval strategy and degradation behaviour on failure, covering hybrid retrieval with RRF fusion, LLM reranking, two-tier caching, circuit breakers, and provider failover. Evaluation is based on a golden dataset and LLM-as-a-Judge, with Recall, MRR, and Groundedness executed in CI.

items.title: Commercializing AI Features
items.description: Developed four features on Claude — match suggestions, chat coaching, icebreakers, and bio generation — integrated as paid subscription items, growing monthly revenue by 81%. Introduced Claude Code into the development process, delivering more than ten features in a single month while maintaining two product lines in parallel.

items.title: Team Leadership & Development Standards
items.description: Led 11 engineers through the delivery of 12 products, owning architecture design and technical decisions. After introducing design review, code review, and a release checklist, release defects decreased by 70% and problem isolation speed improved by 50%.
